title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Close your eyes, don't rush to open them. They may feel slightly hot, that's normal... Shh, stay calm, I crushed some herbs to help your eyes relax. You must have been staring at some dangerous thing. I do that a lot, trust me.

title: Talk 1
original: A guide...? I guess Simone is a better fit for the job. She's also a veteran hunter like me, so I know you'll be in good hands, and won't get into... trouble. There have been some misunderstandings and a few tribes now turn me away. Just remember, if anyone tells you I'm a man eater, they're lying.

title: Talk 2
original: Hands off. I've told you before, no one gets to touch my bow. Not you, not the smiths. You don't have the skills to hunt shadows in the depth of Sami, so you shouldn't draw their attention. I know your kind, I know you're curious. I'll just repeat myself over, over, and over again until I get through to you.

title: Talk 3
original: Check the logs from the research teams. See? These little hornbeasts are friends, they're harmless. And this kind of snow needs Arts to control, so call me if you run into some. Good, go ahead and add some notes to these pictures, you're pretty clever. Why the look? Is it so strange that I know how to use electronics?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: You all are strange, just like Magallan, insisting on comprehending the land on your own terms. I've seen your hard work, you'll come to know the whole of Sami as you see her in your dreams someday. But now? You aren't there yet. I'm worried about you, but since we're working together, just listen to me and you'll be fine.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Put that navigation instrument down, you're no professional, it's wearing you out just carrying it around. Let me lead the way, just like Arges used to do for me. She always says pitfalls and pains guide you to destiny, but I find I can get where I want by just following the sound of the breeze and the twigs in the trees.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: You've never tried sleeping on a cave floor before? What about a bed made of vines? You should give it a try, I can't get a good night's sleep if I don't hear the heartbeat of Sami. How could I even close my eyes if I can't wake the moment I get a vision...? Yes, I have a lot of nightmares, what about it?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: ...You called for me? Did you come across some trouble? If everything's fine, let me sit here alone for a while... I'm looking at the dead. The unsullied dead will walk among the beasts of the forest... I'm still looking for my parents.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Have I ever gotten lost? Hmm... Maybe. I left my home at first to find revenge, but when I saw all that sullied snow, I could only think to draw my bow and aim, to show the shadows that I was the true hunter. Can you be a hunter, too? Or can you be a companion to carry me out of danger when I'm hurt?

title: Idle
original: Does the Doctor have the same kind of dreams that I do? Hm, probably not, we aren't in Sami, after all... Lucky enough for you, the shadows won't be chasing you through your dreams then.

title: Onboard
original: If you come across any abnormalities while we're working together, I'll take care of them for you... Codename? Typhon is my only name. I found it on the horn ornament my mother left behind. Some people say it sounds scary, though.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Are you trying to show off your camera skills? No...? But how can you even call this combat experience, if you don't experience it yourself?

title: Promotion 1
original: Um, what's this promotion badge for again? If it's useless in combat, then let's wait until we settle the danger right in front of us, then you tell me the story behind it.

title: Promotion 2
original: Many travelers to Sami find death in avalanches caused by loud boasting, or other arrogant behavior. They never even get a chance to see Sami's shadow. You won't make the same kind of mistake, not with me accompanying you.

title: Added to Squad
original: Take these weapons and tools. We need them more than extra hands.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Got it, I'll take the lead. Don't be nervous, I can handle this.

title: Depart
original: Stay close, don't run off.

title: Begin Operation
original: Don't let them out of sight, even if your eyes are hurting.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Stay calm and make your move. No need to worry, I've got your back.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: What do you need of me?

title: Deployment 1
original: Time to choose our prey.

title: Deployment 2
original: Good timing.

title: In Battle 1
original: I'll pin you to your shadow.

title: In Battle 2
original: Cowards break the silence first.

title: In Battle 3
original: Nature should not be disturbed.

title: In Battle 4
original: Get out of my home!

title: 4-star Result
original: Each of my arrows slows the black that taints the Sami snow.

title: 3-star Result
original: I see you managed to complete a mission without causing any unnecessary pain to the quarry. Um, not bad, not bad. Sip a hot drink and get some rest.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: If you've run out of arrows or let your target escape, then you should give up the chase. You've already lost.

title: Operation Failure
original: Grasp these seeds tightly in your hand, and run. Don't look back. I'll take care of things here.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Can you explain how these machines work? I've got a good memory, Magallan explained the structure of the research station last time, and I still remember it all... Well, at least, I think I do.

title: Tap
original: Nope, you'll have to be faster than that to even think about faking an attack.

title: Trust Tap
original: Do you have someone you trust standing guard? I want to rest for a bit, your camp is so warm…

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Oh, there have been more and more people celebrating this festival. Will you have a feast too? What about fireworks? Always? Seems I've come to the right place. I'm going to look around for activities I've never tried before, so you don't have to entertain me.

title: Greeting
original: What's up, Doctor. Where have you been? You're not lost, are you?

title: Birthday
original: I helped you find a safe spot. Trees, water from freshly melted snow, the rotting flesh of beasts buried in the soil—you have to thank them for joining your spirit and letting you walk on this land. Come, take my hand.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: It's good practice to always check up on your prey, because the hunt never truly ends. I've seen you defeat many opponents and save many lives. Good on you, but... you wish to fully wipe your enemy from the face of this land? No, a permanent extermination is just wrong.
